seguridad.desbloquearMotivo: Unlock QFaith to see your private content.
seguridad.fraseRecuperacionDescripcion: These 24 words are the only way to recover your private content if you lose access. Keep them somewhere safe and don't share them with anyone.
seguridad.fraseRecuperacionAviso: No one else can recover them for you, not even us.
seguridad.fraseRecuperacionInstruccion: Write them down on paper and keep them where you'd keep an important document. Don't take a screenshot.
seguridad.verificacionDescripcion: Type the words we ask for. That way we know you wrote them down correctly.
seguridad.verificacionErrorPalabra: This word doesn't match. Please check your notes.
seguridad.verificacionCorrecta: All good. Your private content is protected.
seguridad.restaurarDescripcion: Type the 24 words of your recovery phrase, separated by spaces.
seguridad.bloqueadoDescripcion: Unlock to see your private content.

vacios.diario: This is where you'll keep what God is doing in your life.
vacios.oraciones: Once you write your first request, it will appear here.
vacios.memorial: This is where you'll remember the prayers God has answered.
vacios.habitos: Choose a habit to start walking with consistency.

onboarding.bienvenidaTexto: A space to walk with God each day, at your own pace.
onboarding.privacidadTexto: Your journal, prayers and notes are encrypted on this device before they leave it. Not even we can read them.
onboarding.habitosTexto: Choose the habits you want to grow. There are no streaks to lose and no reproach here.
onboarding.iaTexto: The AI helps you study the Bible and prepare devotionals. It never speaks for God and never replaces your pastor.
onboarding.iglesiaTexto: You can join your community for events and groups. Your private content stays private.
onboarding.crearCuentaTexto: Create your account to keep your spiritual history and restore it on any device.

autenticacion.contrasenaCorta: Your password needs at least 8 characters.

diario.descripcion: Whatever you write here is encrypted on your device before it leaves.
diario.campoCuerpo: What do you want to remember about today?
diario.ayudaEtiquetas: Separate them with commas. They're encrypted too.
diario.sinEntradas: You haven't written anything yet. It'll be here whenever you want.
diario.ilegibles_one: There is 1 entry this device can't open.
diario.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} entries this device can't open.

errores.tituloVacio: Give it a title, even a short one.

oracion.descripcion: Your requests are encrypted on your device. So are the names.
oracion.campoTitulo: What do you want to pray about?
oracion.ayudaPersonas: Separate them with commas. They never leave your device unencrypted.
oracion.sinPeticiones: Your requests will live here. Write the first one whenever you want.
oracion.ilegibles_one: There is 1 request this device can't open.
oracion.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} requests this device can't open.

errores.tituloVacio: Write what you want to pray about.
errores.tituloLargo: That's too long for a title.
errores.demasiadasPersonas: That's too many people for one request.
errores.avanceVacio: Write the update before saving it.

oracion.sinAvances: You haven't written anything about this prayer yet.

habitos.descripcion: Steadiness, at your own pace. Only what you do gets recorded here.
habitos.campoTitulo: What do you want to cultivate?
habitos.sinHabitos: Your habits will live here. Start with a small one.
habitos.ilegibles_one: There is 1 habit this device can't open.
habitos.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} habits this device can't open.

errores.tituloVacio: Write what you want to cultivate.
errores.tituloLargo: That's too long for a title.

biblia.sinConexion: This chapter isn't downloaded and you're offline right now.
biblia.sinNotas: You haven't written anything about this chapter yet.
biblia.notaPrivada: Your notes are encrypted. The Bible text isn't yours and isn't stored with them.

errores.notaVacia: Write the note before saving it.

marcas.sinMarcadores: When you save where you are, it'll show up here.
marcas.sinSubrayados: When you highlight a passage, it'll show up here.

biblioteca.descripcion: Your journey, organised. Nothing is copied here: each card points to its original.
biblioteca.sinElementos: Once you write in your journal or save a prayer, it'll show up here.
biblioteca.ilegibles_one: There is 1 card this device can't open.
biblioteca.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} cards this device can't open.
biblioteca.clasificacionLocal: Sorting happens on your device. The server doesn't know what any of this is about.

ia.descripcion: A companion, not an authority. It never speaks for God or replaces your church.
ia.campoMensaje: What would you like to talk about?
ia.sinConversaciones: Your conversations will show up here. They're private and encrypted.
ia.memoriaBorrada: Everything was erased. No copy remains.
ia.avisoEnvio: To reply, this conversation has to be sent to the provider. Nothing else is sent: not your journal, not your prayers, not your notes.
ia.crisis: What you're sharing matters, and you shouldn't carry it alone. Please talk to someone right now: call an emergency service in your country, or call or message someone you trust who can be with you today. If there's immediate danger, get medical help now. I can stay here with you, but I can't replace a person by your side, and nobody is reading this conversation.
ia.respaldo: I'd rather not answer that. I can walk with you through what the Bible says and help you think it over, but that decision is yours and belongs with the people who know you.
ia.sinConexion: I need a connection to reply. The rest of the app keeps working.

errores.sinAutorizacion: We need your permission to send this conversation.

ia.avisoCrisis: This needs a person, not an app.
ia.confirmarBorrado: Delete every conversation? This cannot be undone.
ia.sinMensajes: Write whatever you want. No one else reads it.

memorial.descripcion: What you have seen God do. Kept here so you can read it again.
memorial.sinMemoriales: You haven't written anything here yet. When you want to remember something that happened, this is where it goes.
memorial.ilegibles_one: There is {{count}} memorial this device cannot read.
memorial.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} memorials this device cannot read.
memorial.campoRelato: Tell it in your own words
memorial.desdeOracion: It came from a prayer you marked as answered.

errores.tituloVacio: Write at least a few words about what happened.
errores.demasiadasPersonas: That's too many people for a single memorial.
errores.fechaInvalida: The date must look like YYYY-MM-DD.

ajustes.analiticaNota: It's off. It never includes anything you write.

bloqueo.biometrico: Ask for fingerprint or face on open
bloqueo.explicacion: Locking discards the keys from memory. Your data stays encrypted; you just need to identify yourself again.

dispositivosPantalla.descripcion: Devices that can sync your account.
dispositivosPantalla.sinDispositivos: Devices you sign in on will appear here.

eliminar.explicacion: Everything of yours will be deleted. We can't read it, so we can't give it back either.
eliminar.pendiente_one: Your account will be deleted in {{count}} day.
eliminar.pendiente_other: Your account will be deleted in {{count}} days.

errores.paisInvalido: The country is two letters, like ES or MX.
errores.biometriaNoDisponible: This device has no fingerprint or face recognition.
errores.biometriaSinConfigurar: Set up fingerprint or face in your phone's settings and come back.
errores.noRevocarEsteDispositivo: To leave this device, sign out.

iglesia.sinIglesia: You don't belong to a church yet. You can join with a code, or keep using QFaith without one: nothing of yours depends on this.
iglesia.solicitudEnviada: Your request is pending. They'll let you know when it's accepted.
iglesia.abandonarConfirmar: Leave this church? You can come back whenever you want.
iglesia.garantia: Your church can never see your journal, your private prayers, your memorial or your conversations. Not the pastor, not an administrator.

grupos.sinGrupos: This church doesn't have groups yet.

mentorias.aviso: A mentor only sees what you share, one thing at a time. Never your journal or your conversations.

compartir.explicacion: An encrypted copy is sent for each person. No one else can read it, not even us. You can withdraw it whenever you want.
compartir.sinComparticiones: You haven't shared it with anyone.
compartir.sinClavePublica_one: Couldn't share with {{count}} person: they haven't opened QFaith on any device yet.
compartir.sinClavePublica_other: Couldn't share with {{count}} people: they haven't opened QFaith on any device yet.

errores.codigoInvalido: That code isn't in the right form.

sermones.descripcion: What you write here is yours. Not even the pastor who preached can read it.
sermones.sinSermones: Your church hasn't published any sermons yet.
sermones.sinNotas: Your notes will appear here. You can also write without a sermon.
sermones.ilegibles_one: There is {{count}} note this device cannot read.
sermones.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} notes this device cannot read.
sermones.campoTexto: What are you taking from this?
sermones.campoDestacado: A line you want to remember

acciones.titulo: What you set out to do
acciones.nueva: Add something you want to do

errores.accionVacia: Write what you want to do.
errores.accionLarga: That's too long for a single action.
errores.fechaInvalida: The date must look like YYYY-MM-DD.

notificaciones.descripcion: Nothing you write ever appears on your lock screen. Not a prayer, not a name, not what an entry is about.

silencio.explicacion: During these hours nothing sounds, except a security alert.

limites.explicacion: You can ask for fewer whenever you want. We'll never send more.

notificaciones.fatiga: You haven't been opening these reminders. Want fewer?

errores.vacio: An alert with no text isn't sent.
errores.lenguajeProhibido: That text uses language QFaith doesn't use.
errores.sinConsentimiento: We need your permission for these alerts.
errores.horaInvalida: The time must look like HH:MM.

pulso.opcional: You can skip it. That's fine.

enPaz.reflexion: Peace needs tending too. Today might be a good day to be thankful for it.
enPaz.oracion: Thank you for this rest. Help me not take it for granted.
enPaz.accion: Write a line about why you're at peace today.

agradecido.reflexion: What you name, you remember. Naming it makes it real.
agradecido.oracion: Thank you for what did go well today.
agradecido.accion: Tell someone you're grateful for them.

ansioso.reflexion: Anxiety isn't a lack of faith. It's a sign that something matters a lot.
ansioso.oracion: I don't know how this will turn out. Stay with me while I wait.
ansioso.accion: Write down exactly what worries you. Sometimes it shrinks when you look at it.

triste.reflexion: Sadness doesn't have to be fixed today. You can just be in it.
triste.oracion: I'm sad and I don't have much more to say. Stay.

cansado.reflexion: Tiredness isn't solved with more effort.
cansado.oracion: I'm worn out. Teach me to stop without feeling guilty.
cansado.accion: Pick one thing you can leave until tomorrow.

tentado.reflexion: Being tempted doesn't say who you are. What you do next doesn't decide everything either.
tentado.oracion: Help me not be alone with this.
tentado.accion: Change place or activity for ten minutes.

confundido.reflexion: You don't always have to decide today. Waiting is a decision too.
confundido.oracion: I can't see clearly. Give me patience while it clears.
confundido.accion: Write down both options without choosing yet.

necesitoDireccion.reflexion: Asking for direction isn't weakness; it's what anyone serious does.
necesitoDireccion.oracion: Show me the next step. One is enough.
necesitoDireccion.accion: Talk to someone who's been through something similar.

alejadoDeDios.reflexion: The distance you feel isn't the distance there is. And coming back is never late or humiliating.
alejadoDeDios.oracion: It's been a while since I talked to you. Here I am.
alejadoDeDios.accion: You don't have to catch up all at once. Start with today.

pulso.hablarConAlguien: Talking to someone you trust helps more than it seems. It doesn't have to be today, but keep it close.
pulso.privacidad: This is yours. Your church can't see it, and it's never used for advertising or to diagnose you with anything.

errores.fechaInvalida: That date isn't in the right form.
errores.notaLarga: That's too long for this note.

archivos.cifradoAviso: Encrypted on your phone before it leaves. No one else can open it.

estado.pending: Will upload when you have a connection

planes.sinPlanes: When you start a plan, it'll show up here.
planes.sinCatalogo: No plans available in your language yet.
planes.reflexion: What did it say to you today? (optional)
planes.teEspera: Your plan is waiting right where you left it.

exportacion.explicacion: It's built here, on your phone. That's the only place your content exists in readable form — not even we can do it for you.
exportacion.aviso: The file comes out unencrypted, so you can open it with other software. Keep it where you'd keep something private.
exportacion.incompleta_one: There is 1 record this device can't open, and it isn't included.
exportacion.incompleta_other: There are {{count}} records this device can't open, and they aren't included.
exportacion.vacia: There's nothing to take with you yet.

suscripcion.invitacion: QFaith works without paying anything. A subscription adds features; it doesn't unlock your life.
suscripcion.noDisponible: You can't subscribe from here yet.
suscripcion.restaurar: I already paid on another phone
suscripcion.siempreTuyo: Whatever happens with the subscription, your content stays yours: you can read it, write it, export it and recover it.

estado.gracia: We couldn't take the last payment. You still have access while you sort it out.
estado.terminaPronto: Your subscription won't renew, and stays active until the period ends.
